The large batch frame exposes Cancel while its initial catalog writer is held
The full large batch view becomes ready while a later catalog writer is held
Large list rows retain the first and last source identities
Browser batches remain explicitly unchecked at both ends of the large list
The measured large batch closes with its readers joined and no accepted save
Large batch projection and cancellation never mutate the catalog
